blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu provincial government has proposed a ₱354.82-million agriculture budget for 2027 to support farmers and fisherfolk as the province prepares for possible drought and prolonged dry spells linked to El Niño. The proposed allocation is part of the provincial government’s ₱14.6-billion budget for next year, which has been submitted to […]...
